headline: Divided Fronts Hold as Heavy Fighting Shifts
war_summary: The latest returns show no new strategic-base events in the freshest two-hour window, but several unsettled fronts remain under pressure. Lykos Isle is the liveliest ledger, with 24 events in 24 hours and ownership divided three Warden to four Colonial, though casualties and enlistments have cooled sharply. Farranac Coast likewise recorded 15 daily events, including activity at Mara, Terra and Scythe, while its four-to-seven split remains unchanged in the packet. Godcrofts logged 15 events around Lipsia and Argosa despite a strong Warden majority and one base standing neutral. Tempest Island saw 12 exchanges across its nine Colonial-held bases, while Fisherman’s Row registered 11 events and retains an eight-to-one Warden advantage. Deadlands, split four Warden to seven Colonial, had five events centered on The Salt March; its enormous casualty totals are easing from the previous comparison window. Away from the ownership ledgers, Clahstra and Weathered Expanse still report the war’s heaviest fighting, though neither shows base movement in the latest day’s record. Several rear sectors remain quiet, with no recorded events and only light activity.
